next_step: Run 1-week POC (throughput + vector DB integration) and produce cost baseline by 2025-02-21
notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B dev tools) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for quick integration and then Dedicated for consistent production throughput. Use-case = embeddings + semantic search for product docs + in-app help. Key asks: throughput for bulk ingest (nightly batches), integration with their existing vector DB, predictable per-query cost and latency SLOs.

Discovery call (2025-01-22): quick intro, they want 2 things: 1) validate embedding throughput for nightly bulk (10M rows/month target, initial index ~8M vectors) and 2) retrieval latency <200ms for top-k queries at 200 qps typical. AE notes: strong cost sensitivity, but willing to commit if Dedicated shows 30-40% TCO improvement vs hosted at scale.

Tech details from product team: "we store metadata in Postgres, use Milvus for vector store today; want to test Pinecone compatibility and see if Redwood Optimize recommendations reduce token spend." They prefer open models (Llama2 / Mistral) for cost but will test Redwood-verified model profiles.

Demo (2025-02-05): Hosted API demo with streaming, embeddings batch examples, routing policies. POC scope agreed: 7-day throughput bench + a nightly batch job emulation, plus an A/B retrieval accuracy check vs current Milvus pipeline. SE introduced integration pattern: Redwood-hosted embeddings -> vector DB (customer-managed) or use Redwood Dedicated with built-in vector caching.

Security & procurement: sent security questionnaire 2025-01-25 (see drive). They require SOC2 + SSO/SAML and KMS integration; legal flagged data residency for EU customers (they have EU customers, but HQ NA). Procurement timeline: expect procurement + legal signoff by end of March if POC good.

POC plan notes:
- Day 0: dataset snapshot (50k docs) and ingestion script provided by CrestWave.
- Day 1-3: embeddings throughput run (parallel batch workers) measure embeddings/sec and per-token cost.
- Day 4-6: index + retrieval load test at target qps; measure p50/p95 latency, recall metrics.
- Day 7: cost/latency report + suggestion deck from Redwood Optimize.

Quotes from calls: "Need to keep nightly job within a predictable window — can't have indexing spill into business hours". AE to confirm Dedicated burst policy and pricing.

Open questions / asks for Redwood:
- Provide a sample Dedicated pricing sheet with burst/overage scenarios for 12-month commit.
- Confirm supported vector DB connectors and best practice for hybrid (Redwood embeddings -> customer Milvus).
- Clarify KV cache behavior for large index retrievals (does cache reduce egress to vector DB?).

Next actions:
- SE (Arjun) to provision test tokens and a sandbox route for batch embedding run (by 2025-02-10).
- AE (Maya) to deliver Dedicated pricing deck and proposed contract template for mid-market (by 2025-02-14).
- Customer to provide ingestion sample and credentials for a staging vector DB (by 2025-02-12).

Stance: High interest in Hosted for dev/test; clear preference to move to Dedicated if POC confirms throughput and unit economics. Procurement is primary blocker but motivated by predictable TCO.

CRM fragments / shorthand from calls:
- "POC: embeddings throughput + retrieval p95 < 250ms"
- "Budget target: keep incremental cost < $0.003/query at scale"
- "Legal: EU data residency—may require routing for EU customers"
- "Drive links: pricing deck + security answers uploaded"

Jira: raised RWINF-2413 for dedicated pricing questions (AE -> Finance).
